results.content: Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen to record or near-record lows, with support among middle-aged voters dropping sharply as economic concerns weigh heavily on his presidency. According to the Economist/YouGov poll conducted July 25-27, just 34% of U.S. adults approve of Trump’s job performance, tied for the lowest point of either his first or second term, while 62% disapprove, yielding a net approval rating of -28.
